name: Bered
title: Descendant of Ephraim
summary: Bered is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Joseph. He is part of Ephraim's lineage and is noted in connection with the genealogies of the tribes of Israel. Little is known about his life beyond his place in the family register.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ephraim's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Bered is listed as the son of Shuthelah and a descendant of Ephraim in the genealogies of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Through Bered, the lineage of Ephraim continues, one of the twelve tribes of Israel, and his descendants play a role in Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Part of Israel's Tribal History
keyEvents.description: Bered's place in the genealogy connects him to Joseph's tribe and God's promises to the patriarchs about a great nation.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Ephraim's Loss
keyEvents.description: The genealogy where Bered is mentioned also contains the account that some of Ephraim's sons were killed by men from Gath, placing the family in a context of conflict and grief.
